package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"testing"
)

func TestNormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticRequestCanonicalizesAndKeepsEmptyArrays(t *testing.T) {
	input := TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest{
		AIExecutionID: "  11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111  ",
		LanguageCode:  " RU ",
		Variables: TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables{
			StudentTurn: TeacherOnboardingSemanticStudentTurn{Text: "  Я начинающий  "},
			OnboardingState: TeacherOnboardingSemanticOnboardingState{
				State:          "draft",
				DraftVersion:   3,
				ProfileVersion: 4,
				AcceptedSlots:  []TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot{},
				ActiveInteraction: TeacherOnboardingSemanticInteraction{
					Kind: "question", UIKind: "choice", PromptText: "  Какой язык? ",
					ExpectedSlots: []string{"self_assessed_experience", "direction_code"},
				},
			},
			DialogContext: TeacherOnboardingSemanticDialogContext{
				Summary:             "  Краткий контекст  ",
				ActiveTeacherPrompt: "  Ответьте на вопрос  ",
			},
			SemanticStage: TeacherOnboardingSemanticStage{
				Kind:                "default",
				PriorCandidateSlots: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot{},
			},
		},
	}

	got, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest(input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalize request: %v", err)
	}
	if got.AIExecutionID != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" || got.LanguageCode != "ru" {
		t.Fatalf("request identity was not canonicalized: %+v", got)
	}
	if got.Variables.StudentTurn.Text != "Я начинающий" || got.Variables.DialogContext.Summary != "Краткий контекст" ||
		got.Variables.OnboardingState.ActiveInteraction.PromptText != "Какой язык?" {
		t.Fatalf("bounded text was not trimmed: %+v", got.Variables)
	}
	if got.Variables.OnboardingState.ActiveInteraction.ExpectedSlots[0] != "direction_code" ||
		got.Variables.OnboardingState.ActiveInteraction.ExpectedSlots[1] != "self_assessed_experience" {
		t.Fatalf("expected slots were not canonicalized: %v", got.Variables.OnboardingState.ActiveInteraction.ExpectedSlots)
	}
	if got.Variables.OnboardingState.AcceptedSlots == nil || got.Variables.SemanticStage.PriorCandidateSlots == nil {
		t.Fatal("empty input arrays must remain non-null after normalization")
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(got.Variables)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(encoded) == "" || containsJSONNull(encoded, "accepted_slots") || containsJSONNull(encoded, "prior_candidate_slots") {
		t.Fatalf("normalized empty arrays were encoded as null: %s", encoded)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticRejectsInvalidBranchesAndBounds(t *testing.T) {
	valid := semanticDomainRequest()
	tests := []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest)
	}{
		{name: "unsupported language", mutate: func(value *TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest) { value.LanguageCode = "de" }},
		{name: "missing student turn", mutate: func(value *TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest) { value.Variables.StudentTurn.Text = " " }},
		{name: "non-draft state", mutate: func(value *TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest) { value.Variables.OnboardingState.State = "completed" }},
		{name: "none interaction with prompt", mutate: func(value *TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest) {
			value.Variables.OnboardingState.ActiveInteraction = TeacherOnboardingSemanticInteraction{Kind: "none", UIKind: "none", PromptText: "unexpected", ExpectedSlots: []string{}}
		}},
		{name: "fallback without prior candidates", mutate: func(value *TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest) {
			value.Variables.SemanticStage = TeacherOnboardingSemanticStage{Kind: "fallback_after_ambiguity", Reason: "ambiguity", PriorCandidateSlots: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot{}}
		}},
		{name: "invalid snapshot origin", mutate: func(value *TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest) {
			value.Variables.OnboardingState.AcceptedSlots = []TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot{{Slot: TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection, CodeValue: "backend", ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9000, Origin: "model"}}
		}},
	}
	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			input := valid
			test.mutate(&input)
			if _, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest(input); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic) {
				t.Fatalf("got err=%v, want invalid semantic error", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestNormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResultRejectsNullArraysAndPreservesEmptyArrays(t *testing.T) {
	valid := TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{
		Schema:         TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode,
		Response:       "Понял.",
		SlotCandidates: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{},
		Questions:      []TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{},
		Uncertainties:  []TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{},
	}
	got, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(valid)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalize result: %v", err)
	}
	if got.SlotCandidates == nil || got.Questions == nil || got.Uncertainties == nil {
		t.Fatal("empty result arrays must remain non-null")
	}
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult){
		"nil candidates":    func(value *TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult) { value.SlotCandidates = nil },
		"nil questions":     func(value *TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult) { value.Questions = nil },
		"nil uncertainties": func(value *TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult) { value.Uncertainties = nil },
		"unknown candidate slot": func(value *TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult) {
			value.SlotCandidates = []TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{{Slot: "unknown", StringListValue: []string{}}}
		},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			input := valid
			mutate(&input)
			if _, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(input); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic) {
				t.Fatalf("got err=%v, want invalid semantic error", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func semanticDomainRequest() TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest {
	return TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest{
		AIExecutionID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		LanguageCode:  "ru",
		Variables: TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables{
			StudentTurn: TeacherOnboardingSemanticStudentTurn{Text: "Я начинающий"},
			OnboardingState: TeacherOnboardingSemanticOnboardingState{
				State: "draft", DraftVersion: 1, ProfileVersion: 2,
				AcceptedSlots: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot{},
				ActiveInteraction: TeacherOnboardingSemanticInteraction{
					Kind: "question", UIKind: "text", PromptText: "Расскажите об опыте.", ExpectedSlots: []string{string(TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience)},
				},
			},
			DialogContext: TeacherOnboardingSemanticDialogContext{},
			SemanticStage: TeacherOnboardingSemanticStage{Kind: "default", PriorCandidateSlots: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot{}},
		},
	}
}

func containsJSONNull(encoded []byte, field string) bool {
	var value map[string]json.RawMessage
	if json.Unmarshal(encoded, &value) != nil {
		return false
	}
	return string(value[field]) == "null"
}
